payload.rebuttal: fixed: The test asserted `events[1] == ("sleep", worktree._RETRY_PAUSE_S)`, comparing the recorded sleep argument against the same module constant the probe mutates, so both sides moved together and the assertion could never fail on a shrunk pause. I changed the assertion to check the sleep call's argument against a literal `60` (`assert events[1][1] >= 60`), independent of `_RETRY_PAUSE_S`. I verified by hand that setting `_RETRY_PAUSE_S` to `0.001` now fails this test with `assert 0.001 >= 60`, then restored the correct value and reran the full suite (3938 passed) and the size gate (920 tokens, under the 1300 ceiling) before committing.
